protocol.architecture: Original GRU unchanged and remains neural context backbone for BOTH origins. Per seed pretrain two unchanged V10 motion-only cores with matched initialization/order: reference prediction is original GRU + learned calibration, or public analytic CV + learned calibration. CV uses only independently reconstructed original public belief reference/velocity. Each motion core sees the SAME original252 history/relative/raw anchor/originalGRU context, but its label residual is relative to its respective GRU/CV origin. Completely freeze both cores and clear gradients before four identically initialized unchanged V10 plain anchored response cores. New wrapper returns originalGRU + optional total motion calibration + anchored response; no extra neural features, no mediator, no original-weight optimization. Each response configuration has the same core/motion parameter budget. Both motion controls and all four response families are retained.
protocol.physical_loss: Unchanged V21 group-equal point-weighted vector L2 on valid nonanchor paired response points plus .001 coordinate response energy. Full-train population weights fixed once; minibatch denominator=batch_size, not sum of random weights. Original GRU and pretrained common motion never optimized by the response stage.
protocol.cost_contrast_loss: Fully valid UNION-horizon calls only. M is detached deployed learned/CV reference. Predicted action effect = C_original(M+R)-C_original(M). Label effect = C_original(T_action)-C_original(T_anchor), detached private supervision only. Per nonanchor candidate absolute effect error divided by max(1, norm of target-path gradient of C_original at M)). Average nonanchor candidates per call, then groups. Cost population weights Ntrain/Ngroups/full_call_count(group), zero for incomplete calls; fixed batch_size denominator. No terminal imputation, truth-bin weighting, low-predicted-cost reward or differentiation into M. Use unchanged V11 full score, including target-independent offsets; validate costs and gradients against original engine before optimization. Unsupported objectives fail closed.
protocol.difference_from_v12: V12's squared task effect on a TRUE reference with weight1 and joint motion/response training failed and remains failed. This tests L1 contrast at the actual frozen DEPLOYED reference, weight.1, frozen common motion, vector-L2 physical response loss, group-population weighting excluding anchor, and the already qualified expanded geometry library. It is a new falsifiable design, not a claim that adding task loss works.
protocol.normalization: Only new V23 train public histories; std floor .01. Public CV reference/velocity independently reconstructed by data audit. No inspected V21 data used for training, normalization or checkpoint selection.
protocol.selection: All final80epoch models and all3seeds retained; ADE-median seed per configuration. Primary cv_cost_l2 fixed before collection/training, cannot switch posthoc. Two complete independent runs must match all18 trained-model checkpoints per run, optimizer/RNG/history, forecasts and summaries. Both origins have independently pretrained, fully frozen common motion; all pretraining and response budgets disclosed.
protocol.primary_improvement_checks: Primary additionally needs median response error <= cv_l2, median normalized deployed-reference cost-contrast L1 <= .95 cv_l2, and positive selected decision-gain interval lower bounds vs matched cv_l2 and gru_cost_l2. Basic gain_vs_motion_only uses the matching origin's independently selected motion control; own_motion uses the selected response model's exact frozen motion component. All use same original complete-cost union support; report actual_unique too. CV control remains UNCALIBRATED public CV, not silently replaced by the improved CV-origin motion control.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Fixed fresh V23 development group-equal descriptive intervals, not untouched holdout or closed-loop qualification.

protocol.diagnostics: All train/dev seeds, legal-point vector response error and magnitude bins/offsets, normalized deployment cost contrast, actual/union original full costs/choices/regrets, weak-response false positives, strong-response error and fixed common weights. No truth-dependent deployment gate or threshold/loss sweep.
protocol.later_required: Offline research eligibility only. Whole optional module off/refusal/failure exact original-entry equivalence, sequential/self-generated candidates, untouched holdout, original8Levels and new-scene enhanced closed-loop capture/safety/latency remain mandatory before any promotion. Preserve original weights/capsule and all historical failures.
protocol.preregistration_amendment: Before ANY V23 collection/replay/training: the initial a309cd6 design used bare analytic CV as one reference. Already inspected V21 public-CV reference ADE .374364 exceeds the .95CV total-ADE threshold .366607; exact anchored response cannot guarantee a sufficient common-motion correction. Both origins now have matched80epoch independent motion calibration, frozen before response learning. No seed/split/data/gate/primary changes, no new V23 outcome inspected; original preregistration commit retained, this revision must be published before collection.
